source: 正在采集 Topgrade 环境

english: Design reference; no source code copied

source: 拆分其配置清单中的独立注册表设置，保留来源；不运行上游捆绑脚本。
english: Individual registry settings adapted with provenance retained. Bundled upstream scripts are not executed.

source: 参考隐私、资源管理器及 LTSC 版本适配；仅整合已审查的单项设置。
english: Privacy, File Explorer and LTSC compatibility references. Only reviewed individual settings are integrated.

source: 整合可独立选择的 Explorer 与用户体验设置；不继承整个精简预设。
english: Individually selectable File Explorer and experience settings, without importing a full debloat preset.

source: 沿用用户逐项选择、计划预览与先记录原值的设计经验。旧项目独立保留。
english: Design experience for explicit choices, plan review and original-value journals. The legacy project remains separate.

source: 后台任务异常结束，未收到执行报告。请查看恢复记录后再继续。
english: The worker ended without a report. Check recovery records before continuing.

source: 后台任务发生异常；请检查已有恢复记录。
english: The worker failed unexpectedly. Check existing recovery records.

english: Windows host identified. Review and confirm the plan before applying.

source: 系统设置，按你的习惯组合。
分类查找、预设起步，逐项检查实际注册表变更。
english: Browse categories or start with a preset, then review exact registry changes.

source: 所有项目默认不选；互斥选项自动替换。
english: Nothing is selected by default. Alternative choices replace each other.
Unable to load the settings catalog

source: 配置组合 · {} 个可选起点
选用组合会替换当前系统设置选择，软件 / 功能 / 维护选择保留。选用后仍可逐项调整。
english: A preset replaces your settings selection and preserves software, feature and maintenance selections. You can adjust every choice.

source: 互斥设置组：{group}。选择此项会移除组内其他已选项。
english: Choice group: {group}. Selecting this item removes other selected alternatives.

source: 调整关键词或分类继续查找。
精确的软件包 ID，由 WinGet 执行安装；安装器可能显示额外的许可与交互提示。
english: Install exact package IDs with WinGet. Installers may show additional license or interaction prompts.

source: 通过 Windows 自身的可选功能机制启用组件，部分功能需要源文件与重启。
english: Enable optional Windows components. Some features require installation sources or a restart.

source: 逐项选择 Windows 内置诊断与维护命令。维护可能耗时，取消需等待当前系统操作返回。
english: Choose built-in Windows diagnostics and servicing commands. Operations can take time; cancellation waits for the current system operation.

source: 这些操作不属于注册表恢复范围。执行历史是操作证据，不提供通用回滚。
english: These operations are outside registry recovery. History records execution evidence, not a general rollback.

source: WinGet 已识别；源、权限与许可要求在执行时再次检查。
english: WinGet identified. Sources, permissions and agreement requirements are checked again when executing.

source: WinGet 尚不可用：需要微软应用安装程序及其执行别名。
english: WinGet unavailable. Microsoft App Installer and its execution alias are required.

source: WinGet 仅在 Windows 执行；这里可选择并导出软件部署方案。
english: WinGet runs on Windows. You can select software and export a deployment plan here.

source: 查看 WinGet 检测详情
搜索名称、软件包 ID 或功能名…
english: Search names, package IDs or features…
Unable to load the deployment catalog

source: 目标：{}。导出不会修改本机。
english: Target: {}. Exporting makes no changes to this computer.

source: 从系统设置、软件部署、Windows 功能或系统维护中逐项选择。
english: Choose individual items from system settings, software, Windows features or maintenance.

source: 导出完整 JSON 方案
执行部署 / 功能 / 维护…
系统设置 · {} 项 · 原值留档、按日志恢复
english: System settings · {} items · Original values journaled for recovery

source: 部署 / 功能 / 维护 · {} 项 · 不属于注册表恢复范围
english: Deployment / features / maintenance · {} items · Outside registry recovery

source: 两类执行分别确认。注册表恢复只覆盖日志中的原值；软件安装、功能启用及维护没有通用回滚。不会自动接受外部安装器的许可协议。
english: Confirm the two execution types separately. Registry recovery covers journaled values only. Software, features and maintenance have no general rollback. External installer licenses are not automatically accepted.

source: 给每次变更，留一条回程路
这里只显示实际生成的恢复日志。恢复会检查原值与当前值的冲突。
english: Only actual recovery journals appear here. Restoring checks for conflicts with current values.

source: 本次会话的部署执行历史
这些日志记录执行结果，不是可恢复的系统设置备份。
english: These logs record execution results. They are not restorable settings backups.

source: 在受支持的 Windows 主机应用配置后，真实的变更日志会出现在这里。
english: Apply settings on a supported Windows host to create actual recovery journals.

source: 好的配置，也应说清来处
配置由 Rust 目录逐项映射与校验；不会下载或执行上游脚本。
english: Each setting is mapped and validated in the Rust catalog. Upstream scripts are not downloaded or executed.

source: 部署目录版本：{} / {} 项任务
系统设置映射固定版本来源；部署项目逐项显示软件包、功能或内置命令及限制。软件本身遵循各自许可证，安装器许可需由你决定。
english: Settings cite pinned sources. Deployment tasks identify packages, features or built-in commands and their limits. Software retains its own license; you decide any installer agreement.

source: 输入现有 JSON 档案的完整路径。载入会替换当前选择。
english: Enter the absolute path of an existing JSON profile. Loading replaces the current selection.

source: 输入新文件的完整路径。为保护现有文件，已存在的路径不会被覆盖。
english: Enter the absolute path of a new file. Existing files are never overwritten.

source: 确认在这台 Windows 上应用
english: Confirm settings on this Windows host

source: 共 {} 项配置，以下是将写入的确切值：
english: {} settings. These are the exact values to write:

source: 每项修改前保存原始值，修改后核对。失败或取消可能留下部分已完成的变更，请按真实报告与恢复日志处理。
english: Original values are saved before each write and verified afterwards. Failure or cancellation can leave completed changes. Review the actual report and recovery journal.

source: 确认执行部署 / 功能 / 维护
这些操作不能由注册表恢复日志撤销。可能需要管理员权限、网络、系统源文件或重启；取消只能在系统允许的边界生效，已经完成的操作仍会保留。
english: Registry journals cannot undo these operations. Administrator rights, network access, sources or a restart may be required. Cancellation follows system boundaries; completed operations remain.

source: 不会自动接受外部安装器的许可协议。软件安装器可能显示交互提示，请自行检查并决定。
english: External installer licenses are not automatically accepted. Installers may show prompts for you to review and decide.

source: 将以这 {} 项替换当前 {} 项系统设置选择；部署、功能及维护选择保留。不会立即修改系统。
english: Replace {} items in this preset for the current {} settings selections. Deployment, feature and maintenance selections remain. No system changes are made now.

source: 此组合不适合当前目标：{error:#}
english: This preset does not fit the selected target: {error:#}

source: 确认替换系统设置选择
恢复只处理这条日志记录的注册表值。若当前值在执行后被其他程序修改，冲突检查会阻止覆盖。
english: Restore affects only registry values in this journal. Conflict checks prevent overwriting values changed later by another program.

source: 请输入完整的绝对路径。
已请求取消。请等待当前操作返回并查看报告，然后关闭窗口。
english: Cancellation requested. Wait for the current operation and review its report before closing.

source: 以当前用户执行，安装器可能要求提升权限
english: Runs as current user; installer may request elevation

source: 当前 Windows 版本不支持执行。可以选择、检查并导出方案。
english: This Windows edition or build cannot execute plans. You can select, review and export them.

source: 当前为预览模式：可选择、检查并导出方案；应用与恢复需在受支持的 Windows 上进行。
english: Preview mode: select, inspect and export plans. Applying and restoring require supported Windows.
